spring-warm.label: Spring · Warm undertone
spring-warm.rule: Your warm undertone is your cue for yellow gold and warmer shades such as cream, coral and olive. As a Spring, keep colours light-to-medium and clear — fresh and sunlit, never heavy, dark or greyed.

why.jewellery: Yellow gold and polished brass sit in harmony with your undertone; let the stones echo coral and peach.
why.hairstyles: Hair in golden blonde, honey, strawberry blonde harmonises with your skin; avoid shades that fight your undertone.
why.makeup: Coral lips with apricot cheeks; eyes in champagne or bronze.
why.clothing: Wear coral, peach and golden yellow near your face; build the base in cream and camel.
why.footwear: Ground your looks in warm beige or golden brown leather; let one pair in coral carry the colour, with yellow gold hardware.
why.office: Anchor in cream and golden brown, add one coral piece near the face, small yellow gold details.
why.party: Your most magnetic shades — coral, apple green or poppy — in a fabric with a little shine, finished with yellow gold.
why.festive: Choose coral or poppy with yellow gold zari and jewellery for weddings, sangeet and festivals.
why.date-night: Soft, touchable textures in peach or apricot that glow in low light, finished with yellow gold.
why.casual: Easy pieces in camel and golden yellow — denim and knits that still flatter.
why.vacation: Airy linens in cream with warm turquoise or peach for sunshine.
why.black-tie: Floor-length clear camel or coral — or a sharp tuxedo in golden brown — finished with yellow gold jewellery or cufflinks.
